profile.summary: AI & Data Engineer / Data Scientist based in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. Experienced in building scalable data pipelines, LLM evaluation harnesses, and clinical ML models with a focus on clean architecture and data normalization.

responsibilities_and_impact: Formulated data normalization protocols and optimized core pipelines to ensure clean, structured, and high‑integrity data infrastructure.
Architected an internal AI sandbox and testing harness to benchmark LLM/ML models, trace execution behavior, and refine bilingual (Vi/En) prompt architectures.
Engineered Customer Intelligence pipelines for a Chat Order platform and built automated software testing frameworks to validate end‑to‑end data flows.
Researched state‑of‑the‑art models and developed data‑centric backend microservices to integrate AI capabilities into production applications.
Handled ~40,900 patient encounters under strict data privacy protocols.

Benchmarked calibrated tree models (XGBoost, LightGBM) against permutation‑invariant neural networks (Deep Sets, Set Transformer) using 5×3 nested patient‑grouped validation, achieving 0.798 AUPRC and 0.952 AUROC.

Engineered measurement‑process negative controls (count‑only, availability‑only, value‑shuffled) to audit informative missingness and prevent workflow‑sensitive models from over‑claiming utility (TRi POD+AI compliant).
Co‑directed technical strategy and community initiatives focused on AI/ML, cloud architecture, and data analytics, engaging 100+ active student members.
Led cross‑functional teams organizing technical bootcamps, workshops, and industry‑expert talks.

project_evidence: Engineered core algorithmic logic for a Multi‑Agent System with 50+ concurrent agents, integrating probabilistic simulation with LLM triggers under macro‑economic constraints. Designed a multi‑provider LLM routing architecture to optimize inference performance, achieving ~0.1 s latency and near‑zero token costs. Implemented rigorous data validation pipelines using Pydantic, enforcing 100% structured JSON outputs to eliminate LLM hallucination runtime crashes.

Developed a cross‑domain medical image classification pipeline that integrates SimCLR‑pretrained feature extractors with a Domain‑Adversarial Neural Network in PyTorch, enabling robust adaptation across disparate imaging datasets.
